Interesting! The map at radius 3 shows NO 'o' blocking object near me — row 7 is `#.@P...` meaning (1,7)='.', (2,7)='@' me, (3,7)='P'. There's no 'o' shown. So the notice board isn't rendered as a blocking tile on the map here, yet the pathfinder says it's in the way.

Wait, the earlier radius-10 map showed `#.@P....#...#` at row 7 too — no 'o' at (2,7). The 'o' objects were at (7,6) and (10,5). So the notice board at (2,7) is NOT shown as 'o' on the map. 

So why can't I move? The pathfinder says "Notice Board at (2,7)" is in the way. Maybe the notice board is a separate object that occupies my tile but the map doesn't render it as 'o' because I'm standing there.

Let me try moving again now — maybe the state changed. Let me try a simple move up.
